verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a coding-oriented terminal that could plausibly ship local git tooling, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers SSH key creation and management (Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA, ssh-agent) for server access, plus a list of local commands that does not include git. Nothing documents GPG support or signing git commits with a GPG or SSH key, and SSH key management for logins is an adjacent capability that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sign my commits with a GPG or SSH key for verification
